main_text.p: tentiæ præclaræ: à rerum initium commendatione faciemus: & quidem [illegible, ~5 letters] cuiusmodi funt,vrbes,arces,domus,hor- rerum fenfi- bus fubiecta- rum laudati- ones. ti,villæ,regiones: propterea quòd horum præ cæteris,magnus in fcribendo vfus ef- fe folet.Commendaturus ergo per literas Vrbis aut re- gionis alicu- ius laus & commenda- tio. vrbem,aut regionem aliquam,argumen- ta fumet ex caufis,quæ eius conditorem, inhabitatores quoque primos atque an- tiquissimos oftendunt. Deinde ex nota- tione appellationes, partim veteres, par- tim recentes petet. Tum ex adiunctis cō- fideratis diligēter fingulis attributis, feu circumftantiis, cuiusmodi foli fit quali- tas, quis fitus, quæ flumina vicina, quæ Reipubl. forma, quæ in Ecclesia religio, quæ in fcholis artium cultura,quæ in Se- natu leges atq; inftituta, quæ inter ciues vitæ atque morum conditio, planum fa- ciet. Poftremò ex effectibus res geftas & præclara facinora commemorabit:profe- ret viros infignes,qui in ea floruerint,aut adhuc floreant: commemorabit illa quæ importari & exportari folent. Magnum etiam hic pondus comparationes habet: fi fcilicet cum alia aliqua vrbe, aut regio- ne clara, nobili, illuftri ea conferatur: & fimilitudo aut difsimilitudo commoni

page.notes: The Greek marginal note at the top of the right margin is too small and faint to read; it is marked illegible. The margin notes are italic and were read with some effort; the hyphenation of the notes is as printed. Line-end hyphens in the text, such as "cō-" in "cō-fideratis" and "diligēter", are kept as printed. The text ends mid-word at the foot ("commoni"), which is a line break on the scan and is kept as is.
